growthAlgorithm: closed swept ring surfaces along parametric growth curves; holdfast boss + haptera fingers, ribbed tapering stipe, flat-lens blade shells

structures.bladeShell: closed thin shell, edge rim is the narrow end of the lens cross-section (no zero-thickness sheet)

bladeDetail.columnPlan: j0=right margin, j1..n=upper face, j(n+1)=left margin, j(n+2)..j(2n+1)=lower face
bladeDetail.pneumatocyst: one basal gas bladder per blade, material slot 3

structures.anchorSocket: object origin at holdfast base (0,0,0); sway measured from it

flowFacingAsymmetry.effects: stipe bend, per-blade downstream sweep, lee-side blades longer/wider, holdfast splayed wider upstream

ngons.note: source surface emits quads and cap triangles only

topology.branchUnion: stipe base and blade sheaths are hidden unions beneath the holdfast boss and the blade root embed; no coplanar intersecting tubes (3DMODEL_FLORA_CORAL.md section 3)

uvRoutes.blades: lengthwise: V from root to tip along the blade curve, U across the sheet from one margin to the other, continuing around the rim onto the underside (3DMODEL_FLORA_CORAL.md section 5)
uvRoutes.stipeAndFingers: cylindrical unwrap, arc-length in both axes, single seam column placed on the rear/lee side
uvRoutes.overlapNote: upper and lower blade faces occupy the same island but distinct U ranges, so no island overlaps another; no unique-baked texture is produced, AO lives in vertex colour B

materialSlotOmission: no slot 3: 3dmodel.md section 6 makes it conditional ('only when needed') and kelp is non-emissive per 3DMODEL_FLORA_CORAL.md section 2. The pneumatocyst is carried by silhouette geometry plus the UVMask parameterisation, not by a fourth submesh over a 4 cm organ -- measured, that band produced a 649.68 distortion outlier at LOD0 and 3.53 px islands at LOD1.

maskUv.uSemantic: 0 and 1 at blade margins, 0.5 on the midrib; tube parts wrap once around from the hidden seam column
maskUv.vSemantic: geodesic distance from the holdfast / longest path, root 0 to farthest tip 1 -- identical field to vertex colour R
maskUv.shaderGap: Hecton_KelpMaster.shader reads TEXCOORD0, which is the ATLAS unwrap; until it is repointed at TEXCOORD1 the sway height mask is an atlas coordinate, not a root-to-tip gradient

vertexColour.alphaMeaning: harvest_mask: 1.0 = frond tissue removed by a cut at ANCHOR_Cut, 0.0 = holdfast and lower stipe that stay rooted
vertexColour.biolumPolicy: authored 0 everywhere; photic-zone kelp has no emissive organ (3DMODEL_FLORA_CORAL.md section 2)

lods.simplification: quadric edge collapse with seam/material border preservation
quadric edge collapse with seam/material border preservation

collision.justification: flora/coral default collision is none per 3DMODEL_FLORA_CORAL.md section 7
collision.interactionProxy: harvest/cut interaction is represented by the serialised ANCHOR_* empties; a trigger capsule at the root is the runtime owner's call per 3DMODEL_FLORA_CORAL.md section 7

notEnforced: uv_stretch_excessive: not enforced: outlier sub-test skipped 792 of 5818 triangles below the sliver floor 6.053e-04 m2 (0.1x mean triangle area 6.053e-03 m2); the area-weighted population test still covered all of them

uv_stretch_excessive: not enforced: outlier sub-test skipped 277 of 1657 triangles below the sliver floor 2.086e-03 m2 (0.1x mean triangle area 2.086e-02 m2); the area-weighted population test still covered all of them

uv_stretch_excessive: not enforced: outlier sub-test skipped 2 of 283 triangles below the sliver floor 1.084e-02 m2 (0.1x mean triangle area 1.084e-01 m2); the area-weighted population test still covered all of them

storedChannelStats.comparableWithRender: min and max are weighting-independent; compare those. areaWeightedMean approximates a pixel average but is not identical to it, because a render also weights by visibility and projected foreshortening.

silhouetteSummary.note: coverage is the occupancy measure; top10 is spike-sensitive triage only

prefabBoundary: PF_/GEN_ prefab, LODGroup and Unity import are NOT produced here: only Unity may author .prefab assets (AGENTS.md Evidence Law). This package is the FBX + manifest the Unity-side assembler consumes.
